summary: Frontend-only verification of the new PredictionPanel on the Insights tab. Logged in as demo@cycle.app via the Sign In form and navigated to Insights at viewport 430x920. All 17 required testIDs render with correct content from GET /api/prediction: prediction-panel (wrapper), prediction-window-card showing 'Jul 2' (predicted date) + 'Likely window Jun 23 - Jul 11' + 'Cycle length ~28d · 13 cycles tracked', prediction-confidence '63%' with prediction-confidence-bar filling 63% in amber, prediction-regularity-chip showing 'Moderately Irregular', prediction-prob-card with the SVG prediction-prob-curve (peak Jul 2 · 63%, axis labels Jun 25 / Jul 8), prediction-trends-card with two trend rows ('Your cycles have been getting shorter recently.', 'Your cycle length has become more variable.'), and prediction-flags-card ('1 cycle(s) were shorter than 21 days.', 'A cycle length changed by more than 10 days 2 time(s).' plus disclaimer). Existing Insights content still renders below the panel: insight-avg-cycle, insight-avg-period, insight-regularity, insight-patterns, insight-symptom-chart, insight-mood-chart — confirmed by bounding-box layout (scrollHeight 1755px on a 836px viewport, content laid out y=88 -> y=1557). No red screen, no API errors, no missing testIDs. Three non-blocking RN-Web / React 19 console warnings observed (deprecated shadow* style, deprecated pointerEvents prop, element.ref removal) — they come from third-party libs, not the new panel. Frontend success rate: 100%.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Emitted on the login screen on load — coming from RN-Web compatibility layer / Card shadow styles. Non-blocking. Reference: search shadowColor / shadowOpacity / shadowRadius usage in /app/frontend/src/components/ui (or theme).

Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely originates from a third-party RN component; if any in-house component passes pointerEvents as a prop, migrate it to style.pointerEvents.

Console error twice on first navigation: 'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19. ref is now a regular prop.' Likely from a third-party lib that still reads child.ref (commonly react-native-svg or expo-router internals). Non-blocking but worth tracking for library upgrades.

action_items: No blocking action for the PredictionPanel feature — it ships green from a frontend integration standpoint.
Optional: remove deprecated shadow* style props from /app/frontend/src/components/ui (Card) / theme in favor of boxShadow on web to silence the RN-Web warning.
Optional: audit components for `pointerEvents` prop and move it into style={{ pointerEvents: '...' }} to silence the RN-Web warning.
(Carry-over from iteration_1) Backend MAD==0 outlier detection bug in /app/backend/prediction_engine.py:114-128 is still outstanding.
critical_code_review_comments: PredictionPanel.tsx ProbabilityCurve sizes the SVG via Dimensions.get('window').width - that works on web because the screen width matches the viewport, but on tablet/landscape this will render a too-wide curve overflowing the card. Consider using onLayout of the parent Card to measure available width instead of Dimensions (low priority).

insights.tsx fetches /analytics, /symptom-patterns, /prediction in parallel; the latter two .catch(() => null) which is good — but the user gets no error UI if /prediction fails. Consider an inline error/retry treatment instead of a silent null (low priority).
PredictionPanel destructures `value: any` on HealthFlag — change to `unknown` and narrow before use to keep medical-grade strictness.
seed_data_creation: None. Used the pre-seeded demo@cycle.app account (13 cycles already tracked).
